maya: Quick heads-up: brief maintenance Wed 01:30 UTC -> 60m window for controller leader rotation on rack `cp-5` (soft reboots). No GPU compute nodes touched.

tony: Are we doing cohorts or single-node rolling?

maya: cohorts of 1, 8m stagger to avoid overlapping elections. Plan: cordon -> drain non-critical control-plane pods -> soft reboot -> kv preseed 5m -> verify.

liam: I'll run a 10m synthetic canary after cohort 2. Abort if p95 control-plane API > 600ms or >1 leader election per 10m.

jamie: Suggest enabling route-shadow for 15m during ops to detect routing regressions before flipping live routes. Also queue status page 3h pre-alert.

hana: Support will prep PSAT and short email to enterprise list. Will include note: Dedicated pools stay local; no customer workload migration.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-3498 created and scheduled. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/controlplane-maintenance. Paging: eng-infra-oncall.

maya: Runbook snippet:
```
infra-cordon --rack cp-5 --nodes 1
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
infra-reboot --type soft
kvcache-seed --delay 300
infra-verify-controlplane --checks etcd,api
```

liam: ACK (sre). I'll post canary link 30m before.

tony: ACK (oncall).

hana: ACK (support). Posting comms now.

maya: Thanks. Will post post-op summary within 12h. Ping here for updates. :thumbsup:
